alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 4 at 12:42PM PST until November 10 at 12:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Minor to locally moderate coastal flooding expected.
Additionally, dangerous rip currents and surf of 3 to 5 feet
expcted along west-facing beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Friday to noon PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Coastal residents and managers of
infrastructure in the advisory area should prepare for rising
water and take appropriate action to protect life and property.
Highest tides will occur in the late morning
